payout_quote: As a thank you for sharing the gift of personalized banking with those closest to you, you will receive a referral bonus of $100 for every referred member who opens an account! For every share savings account opened by a referred member within the current calendar year, we'll pay members in good standing a referral bonus of $100. A minimum of 90 days of account opening is required before the bonus can be paid.
steps: As a current PFCU member in good standing, complete the online referral form (or submit in person) with your name matching your account.
Give the referral to a friend or family member who is eligible for PFCU membership.
They open a new Power Financial Credit Union share savings account as primary owner, presenting the referral at account opening.
They keep the account open for at least 90 days.
After the 90-day period, $100 cash is deposited into your account.
catches: Referred member must open a new share savings account as primary owner and keep it open at least 90 days — bonus is paid only after that period.
Referred member cannot have any existing or prior Power Financial Credit Union account and must be 18 or older.
Referral card must be presented when the account is opened and the referring name must match the PFCU account.
PFCU employees are not eligible to participate.

Membership eligibility: live, work, or go to school in listed FL counties (Broward, Charlotte, Collier, Lee, Martin, Miami-Dade, Monroe, Palm Beach, Hillsborough, Manatee, Pinellas, Sarasota, St. Lucie), or employees of FPL/NextEra, Ryder System, Bonefish & Tarpon Trust members/employees, or immediate family of current members.
Promotion ends December 31st of the current year.
A 1099 may be issued for the value of the gift as income.
Cannot be combined with other offers.
biggest_catch: The referred friend's share savings account must stay open 90 days before the $100 is paid; promotion ends December 31, 2026; PFCU employees are excluded; membership is limited to South Florida eligibility (FL counties, select employer groups, immediate family of members).
eligibility: Referrer must be a current PFCU member in good standing (name matching the account); referred friend must be 18+, meet PFCU membership eligibility, and have no existing or prior PFCU account.
timing: Referral share takes ~5-15 minutes active; $100 deposited into the referrer's account after the 90-day account-opening period is met.
